name: Dual regime gate + crowded-short funding filter arms RSI-oversold reversion
rationale: THESIS: an RSI-oversold dip armed by the dual macro/vix regime gate reverts hardest when perps funding is NEGATIVE (shorts are paying, i.e. crowded-short) — the short crowd becomes squeeze fuel. funding_rate is BOUNDED (~+/-0.01) so a fitted lt threshold is valid. The dual regime gate is the arming switch; funding<floor is the crowding refinement. Long-only spot harvests the squeeze without touching the perp. DISCONFIRMER 1 (does funding add over the dual gate?): spec-2 (same dual gate + RSI, NO funding) is the baseline. DISCONFIRMER 2 (is it the squeeze or just any oversold?): a sibling with funding>0 (longs crowded) on the same gate should be WORSE; if equal, funding sign is inert. DISCONFIRMER 3 (just buy-the-dip?): ungated RSI control. DISCONFIRMER 4 (holdout). funding_feature stays null because funding is used as an ENTRY gate, not a carry leg.
catalyst: funding_rate negative (crowded short) with RSI oversold under a risk-on calm-vol regime
